t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are colours the represent the gnomes and colours that represent the baskets. Click on the nome colour which gives you the best result. Keep clicking until the score is no longer high. If both scores are low, keep changing the gnome you pick.

vb_textbox.text: The Gnomes Represent the colour of the basket in the woods. Match the basket in the woods with the colour of the Gnome. Always hitting the correct colour with the colour of the gnome will get you the most mushrooms.
